text:
eli: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout this Thu 02:00 UTC: runtime v2.3.1 -> API v1.9.0 -> console v5.4.0 -> router v3.2.
monica: Ack, adding to release board. I put the release notes draft here: https://internal.redwood/release/171203 — can folks skim?
ryan: Quick ask: are we pinning router to the non-eviction variant for the first wave?
eli: Yes, pin router to `router-3.2-stable` for waves 1/2. We'll relax in wave 3 if metrics look good.
hannah: I ran a tiny drift-scan against the staged stack this morning — KV eviction rates look normal but there's a tail on p99 latency for runtime with seq len ~2k.
sre-oncall: noted. What's our rollback trigger? p95>200ms for >5m or error spike >0.5%?
eli: Rollback criteria: any of — 1) 5m rolling p95 increase >2x baseline, 2) client error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m, 3) fatal deploybot alert. If triggered, immediate pin back to previous model/variant and circuit traffic.
monica: Release notes updated with the rollback criteria and known runtime p99 tail. Also listed console UI tweak and API schema bump (minor).
ryan: For the API schema bump, we need the router to support the new header passthrough for 1 hour post-cutover. I added a short-lived routing rule in the runbook.
deply-bot: (automated) scheduled deployment window set for 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z, quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary wave 1: 5% traffic, wave 2: 25%, wave 3: 70%.
eli: small correction: deploy-bot entry — can we make wave 2 20% not 25%? want a slower ramp given p99 note.
deply-bot: (automated) update acknowledged — wave 2 set to 20%.
hannah: Ops checklist in runbook includes: preflight KV warmup, prefix cache fill, router sticky-session toggle, canary metrics dashboard link: https://dash/internal/canary/171203
ryan: I'll own the router fallback if sticky sessions cause skew. Plan: if canary shows >10% request steering delta vs control, we pause and pin router to prior variant.
monica: Docs and release-notes final — tagging legal for telemetry line. Also uploading changelog to release artifact bucket.
sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring infra channel and smoke alerts. tagging incident playbook 42. If we need to roll back, who makes the call?
eli: SRE or Product SE can call rollback within first 30m. After 30m, make a sync and decide. If deploy-bot posts `fatal` alert, auto rollback kicks in.
hannah: one more: add a short post-release eval job to run 1000 sample prompts through runtime+api to confirm quality drift <0.5 BLEU change. I added the eval config to the runbook.
ryan: got it. I'll queue the eval job at wave 2 completion.
eli: thanks team. final preflight tomorrow 18:00 UTC — please join if you're on call. :thumbsup:
